**Rapid scan.** The camera stays open: tap the shutter for one card, then go straight on to the next. Each photo goes to your server the moment it is taken and is read in the background while you carry on. Results collect in a tray along the bottom.

**Check before adding.** Tap a result to see your photo next to the match, then choose the condition, variant, language, quantity and what you paid. One tap adds it and the next waiting card opens. The condition and variant you used last are suggested for the next card, and if the scanner picked the wrong card you can pick another match.

**Duplicates.** Every result is marked NEW, or ×3 if you already own three. The check panel lists those copies by condition, variant and language. Until your collection has loaded it says so instead of guessing.

**Nothing gets lost.** Photos that could not be sent (no signal, app closed) are kept and sent next time, and scans still waiting on your server are picked up when you open the camera.

**Fixes.** The OK on error messages was red on dark red and could not be seen. Text buttons such as Refresh are lighter, and the collection count and the sign-in buttons no longer get cut off.

**Changed.** The "read each card on its own" option is gone: every photo is now read as its own card, which is one call to your scanner provider per card.
